english.title: Contravene a provision contained within building regulations under the Building Act 1984 - England
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) contravened a provision contained in building regulations, namely **(..SPECIFY THE CONTRAVENTION AND THE BUILDING REGULATION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to the above building regulation and section 35 of the Building Act 1984.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) This offence applies from the 1st October 2023 due to changes made by the Building Safety Act 2022. For the offence applying before this date see H9358.
(ii) This offence applies in England only. For the Welsh offence see H101802.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant contravened a provision contained in building regulations, namely **(..SPECIFY THE CONTRAVENTION..).

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: maximum 6 / 12 months imprisonment and / or a fine
Indictable: maximum 2 years imprisonment and / or a fine in either case, a person will also be liable to a further fine not exceeding level one on the standard scale for each day on which the default continues after he is convicted.

The maximum penalty on summary conviction may be 6 or 12 months depending on the general limit in a magistrates’ court, see section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2022.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
